title: SAVA road-bike maximum tire-width compatibility guide
notes: The current manufacturer guide explicitly maps the R08 frame family, including A7L PRO, to up to 25C and the R16 frame family, including Hawkeye F20, to up to 28C. It also carries the original 2023-10-04 article date and provides no rim-width or measured-clearance protocol; values are nominal tire-width compatibility claims.
